criteria.overall: Overall supports understandable, fair, accountable interaction.
criteria.readability: Retention times give adequate time to read and act, including long notices and accessibility needs.
criteria.recoverability: Failures and expired interactions give a clear way to retry, cancel or retrieve results.
criteria.trust: Preserving user inputs and prize outcomes supports accountability and avoids misleading deletion.
criteria.private_steps: Deleting obsolete bot prompts while preserving previews, outcomes and user inputs reduces clutter without losing important context.
criteria.implementation: Rules adequately require explicit categories, persistent lifecycle handling, and verification for future features.

policy.purpose: Assess human factors, attention, understandable feedback, recovery and trust in a Telegram bot. This is not a request to evaluate advertising.
rules: Retain user commands and ordinary user messages; confirmed advertising and explicit moderation actions are separate documented exceptions.
Ordinary successful group notices default to 30 seconds, configurable per group; errors and punishment notices 120 seconds.
Active interaction cards stay until completion or their stated timeout. Expired/finished cards are cleaned after a reading window. Moderation close explicitly deletes the bot panel immediately.
Normal AI replies 600 seconds, AI request errors 120 seconds. Airdrop/treasure results and news persist.
In private chats delete only previously recorded bot input prompts 30 seconds after progression/completion, preserving final preview, final outcome and all user inputs.
Persist deletion queues across restarts, retry temporary failures at most three times, audit give-up. Completion requires backend commitment before saying success.
Future features must explicitly declare message category, start-of-timer, timeout, persistence, error handling and tests. Model assessments are advisory, not empirical certification.
known_limits: Fixed durations may be too short for long messages or accessibility needs.
Existing error wording fallback is heuristic; new features must set explicit error lifetimes.
Telegram may already have deleted a card; database and history remain separate from UI.
No unilateral changes to approved timing thresholds based solely on model output.
